note: RV resort at mile 82.5 of Lake of the Ozarks near Warsaw, mostly annual and seasonal sites; the 16 overnight sites (115-130) sit together by the office and boat storage, about 450-550 m from the shore. Pool, boat ramp and fishing docks. No full-time living; RVs must be in good working order and carry liability insurance. --Claude
summary: Added fees $45 ($65 holiday weekends, +8% engine fee), 50A/water/sewer, 60 ft pull-throughs, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi, booking via the operator's Park engine. Mostly annual/seasonal park: 16 overnight of ~130 sites - long-stay borderline, flagged. Waterfront lead lakeview -> not waterfront for the overnight sites.
flags: LONG-STAY BORDERLINE (human decision): the operator page leads with 'annual RV sites, seasonal and overnight sites' and 'a community enjoying long weekends at the lake'; annual sites $220/month plus electricity via a Rent Manager 'Apply for an Annual Site' application (17 annual sites listed available), seasonal sites (spoonbill Mar-Apr, regular May-Oct) call for pricing. Only 'a handful of overnight sites': the engine lists 16 (115-130), 10 of them marked bookable. Five tests: (1) price $45 base <= $50 PASS ($65 holiday weekends, and the 8% engine service fee takes the base to ~$48.60 - still under); (2) nights for sale PASS (posted nightly rate on its own page, phone 855-488-8998, a booking engine selling 1 night; the application is for annual sites only); (3) no minimum over 2 nights PASS (engine minimum 1 night, no weekend minimum); (4) 16 nightly of ~130 numbered sites ~12% PASS narrowly; (5) RV resort, not a home community PASS ('do not allow full-time living'; no home sales seen, though the operator Grace Communities also runs manufactured-home communities). Mostly seasonal in character but passes every test and rates 4.9, so not an automatic drop.

OCCUPANCY UNVERIFIED: Google reviews could not be loaded (the sort control timed out; only the 4.9 (12) header read), and the engine's dated availability did not load over plain HTTP. Whether transient nightly guests are a real share of the park is unconfirmed.
Google Maps: 4.9 stars (12 reviews), 'RV park'. Under the 25-review presence line, but the operator's own page with a phone carries presence.
